parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword that is used to search for Logstore groups.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SLSGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the Logstore group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-hybrid-monitor-sls-group --keyword Logstore --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --sls-group-name Logstore_test --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeHybridMonitorSLSGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Keyword Logstore --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SLSGroupName Logstore_test
